FOR OFFENCES P/U/S 5(J)(II),5(L),6 OF POCSO ACT, 2012,
U/S 3(1)(w),3(2)(v) OF SC/ST (POA) AMENDMENT ACT, 2015 AND SEC. 376(3) OF IPC, PENDING ON THE FILE OF ADDL.

2. In view of the Memo for withdrawal, the appellant is permitted to withdraw this appeal as not pressed.
